summary.intent: Get caliper to a v1 alpha by creating and executing six Entire trails (comparison/oracle, perf, detection, release flow, etc.), then later making the built-in checker the default while keeping Caliper at least 2-3x faster than react-docgen-typescript.
summary.outcome: Six trails were created (#153-#158) and Wave 1 workers produced stacked draft PRs (#280-#283 for oracle and weekly pairing; #441 making the checker default; #442 weekly on checker, merged into #441). The trail 154 perf branches and trail 158 release-flow stack were built or in progress; the checker-extract speed worker crashed on an API error, was recovered, and is still finishing, with no RDT-vs-checker numbers reported yet.

repo: Plan lives outside the repo at ~/.claude/projects/-Users-gabe-Projects-caliper/plan/next-trails-2026-11-02.md; trails are created with `entire trail create`, branches linked with `entire trail link N --branch X --base Y` before PRs exist, which makes Entire open the PRs with a marker that must be kept in edited bodies.
Stacked PRs need `--base <parent branch>` when linking; retarget to main after the parent merges.

Callisto is at 0.16.0 locally researched (CI uses 0.20.0); GitHub Release artifact slots require product package to be Cargo (cargo/caliper-docgen), attestations verified against a signer workflow named callisto-release.yml (unconfirmed in source), so release.yml may need renaming.

The failed release run was an E148 snapshot race in the version-pr step; re-running or the next push fixes it. No GitHub Releases exist yet, only tags; callisto.toml lacks github-release in publish-to.
Homebrew tap reads tag npm/caliper-docgen@x.y.z, so tag-template must stay unset.

Checker default cost: gate-large (938 components) ~6 s / ~970 MiB vs ~0.09 s / ~200 MiB with --no-checker; the 17-39x RDT speed claim only applies to --no-checker. RDT takes ~10.4 s on the benchmark project.

Weekly budgets for the five corpora are None ('record on first run'); rule is 1.5x time and 1.25x memory of the larger of two scheduled runs. UNIVERSE_VERSION bumped to 5 to avoid false 'wrong types rose' issues.

Storybook addon already does structural-first with checker in background (semanticWaitMs 150 ms, prefetchStories default 1) but lacks a live upgrade of an open story when the checker answer arrives late.
Under the sandbox, `tsx` fails on its IPC socket (EPERM); `node src/oracle.ts` works since Node 26 strips types. The job tmp dir is write-denied, so use $TMPDIR.
react-docgen does follow imports (default fsImporter) and throws on 17-21% of files in antd/shadcn.

code.finding: A refused createSnapshot/updateSnapshot response now calls discard() to release the snapshot it created (fix 10df5137 for finding on change #238); a timed-out caller's snapshot is released at line 446.
AnswerCache::shared shares one copy of identical props across checker answers in a session, cutting Storybook session memory from ~6.7 MiB per component to a 1,058 MiB peak for 938 components.

workflow: Subagent and teammate messages carry no user authority; the classifier blocked `entire trail finding resolve` as an external write, so the assistant reported the command for the user instead.
Workers should commit and push early with remote SHA verified (git ls-remote) so work survives a crash or accidental stop.
Machine load heavily skews timing; compare only interleaved side-by-side runs and strip durationMs when hashing output.
Brain `brief` failed on a sandbox write-lock denial under ~/.local/share/entire/ and was not retried outside the sandbox.
